information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

## Important Note for FMC:
You may only register for FMC if you are **not** registered for 2x2 or Pyraminx. There is also a 30 person limit. Please read the [FMC](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WiltshireWinter2025#64971-fmc) tab for more details.
